QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_2

question.text: Saraswati Absolute Return Fund is a Category III AIF investing in listed equity derivatives. What is the conventional base for calculating management fees for a Category III AIF?

answer.text: Gross Net Asset Value (GNAV) computed periodically
Subscription price of units at launch

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 9.1, Cat III AIFs charge mgmt fees as 1% to 2.5% of GNAV, computed periodically (monthly/quarterly) when GNAV is calculated. Fee accrues from First Close to dissolution. The Trap: Option A is Cat I/II basis. Option C is closer to PE fee convention. Option D freezes the base incorrectly. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B tests Cat III fee mechanics for distributors; XIX-C requires the manager to understand GNAV computation (gross of liabilities but before fees/incentives). Manager's Pro-Tip: When computing GNAV, always agree with the Trustee and fund accountant whether mark-to-market unrealised gains on OTC derivatives feed into GNAV — this can swing management fee accrual materially, and the PPM language should be unambiguous.
